definitions.explanation: The ratio of useful output to total input; how effectively time, resources, or effort are used to produce results.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{効率|こうりつ}を{上|あ}げたい。
examples.english: I want to improve my work efficiency.

examples.japanese: この{方法|ほうほう}は{効率|こうりつ}が{悪|わる}いので{変|か}えよう。
examples.english: This method is inefficient, so let's change it.

examples.japanese: AIを{導入|どうにゅう}したことで、{業務|ぎょうむ}の{効率|こうりつ}が{大幅|おおはば}に{改善|かいぜん}された。
examples.english: By introducing AI, work efficiency was significantly improved.

notes:
The ratio of useful output to total input. Very common in business, engineering, and daily life to describe how well resources (time, energy, money) are used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {効率|こうりつ}がいい/{悪|わる}い: efficient/inefficient
- {効率|こうりつ}を{上|あ}げる: to improve efficiency
- {効率|こうりつ}が{落|お}ちる: efficiency drops
- {作業|さぎょう}{効率|こうりつ}: work efficiency
- {燃費|ねんぴ}{効率|こうりつ}: fuel efficiency

FORMS:
- {効率的|こうりつてき}（な）: efficient (na-adjective — extremely common)
- {効率|こうりつ}{化|か}: making things more efficient
- {非効率|ひこうりつ}: inefficiency

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {能率|のうりつ}: productivity, efficiency (more focused on human labor)
- {生産性|せいさんせい}: productivity (economic term)
